PROMISE: Complete Phase-1 of Bharatmala Project expeditiously
STATUS AND COMMENTS: The original deadline for completion has been extended by six years to FY28. The cost has more than doubled, and as of November-end, only 42% of the project has been completed. There are significant increases in per kilometer cost, and due to financial constraints, the pace of awarding projects has been slow.

PROMISE: Develop National Highways Infrastructure
STATUS AND COMMENTS:
- Total length of national highways increased by 60% to 1,46,145 km by December 2023.
- Four-lane and above highways increased by 2.5 times to 46,179 km.
- High-speed corridors length increased to 3,913 km.
- Decrease in less developed highways from 30% to 10%.
- Road Ministry constructed 6,217 km of national highways up to December in the 2023-24 financial year.
- Expenditure on highways construction expected to increase by 9.4 times to ₹3.17 lakh crore.

PROMISE: 100% waste collection to achieve ODF+ and ODF++
STATUS AND COMMENTS: Govt: All cities declared ODF; significant infrastructure for waste management built. Reality: Persistent manual scavenging, misreported ODF status, deaths during scavenging, issues with fund allocation and toilet usage.

PROMISE: Achieve 175 GW of renewable energy capacity
STATUS AND COMMENTS: 119 GW achieved out of 175 GW. Solar: 62 GW; Wind: 42 GW; Bio-Power: 10.7 GW; Small Hydro: 4.9 GW. Including large hydro: 165.94 GW.

PROMISE: Strive to achieve 10% blending of ethanol in petrol
STATUS AND COMMENTS: Ethanol Blending Goal: 10% achieved, aiming for 20% by 2025. Ethanol primarily from grains and sugarcane. Environmental Impact: Reduction in greenhouse gas emissions. Implementation Phases: Gradual expansion to 20% blending. Raw Material Challenges: Reliance on water-intensive crops, supply issues, and price fluctuations. Sugar Industry’s Role: Crucial in ethanol production, affected by rainfall patterns and potential export bans.

PROMISE: Connect every Gram Panchayat with high-speed optical fiber
STATUS AND COMMENTS: BharatNet Expansion: Target expanded to 6.4 lakh villages with Rs 1.4 trillion budget. Current Progress: 1.94 lakh villages connected, 203,436 gram panchayats service-ready, and 669,012 FTTH connections provided. Future Plans: BSNL to use satellite and FWA technologies for remote areas, implementation set to begin by 2024.

PROMISE: Supply of piped cooking gas in major Tier 1 and 2 cities
STATUS AND COMMENTS: Significant progress with 300 Geographical Areas authorized, covering 98% of the population. Target of 12.5 crore PNG connections by 2030. Over 82% land area and 98% population expected to be covered.

PROMISE: Increase port capacity to 2500 MTPA
STATUS AND COMMENTS: Slow utilization of funds for Sagarmala projects: Out of 44 projects, funds have not been released for 31 | Inadequate project completion: Only 15 out of 60 sanctioned projects completed | Budget allocation and utilization issues: Reduced allocation in Revised Estimates and unutilized funds in areas like the Indian Maritime University and IWAI | Turnaround time improvement: Average turnaround time at Indian ports reduced from 52.80 hours in 2014-15 to 50.01 hours in December 2022, but still higher than international standards | International performance: India's major ports not in the top 20 globally on any performance index and low score on liner shipping bilateral connectivity index.

PROMISE: Ensure conversion of all viable rail tracks to broad gauge by 2022.
STATUS AND COMMENTS: - Completed 2022 TKM of new lines, gauge conversion, and multi-tracking by 12th December 2022. | - Doubling and multi-tracking increased from an average of 375 km/year (2009-14) to 1394 km/year (2014-22). | - Major projects like Daund-Gulbarga doubling, Vijayawada-Gudivada-Bhimavaram doubling, Secunderabad-Mahbubnagar doubling. | - Notable gauge conversion projects include Ahmedabad-Himmatnagar-Udaipur. | - New line projects such as Bhadrachallam-Sattupalli in Telangana. | - Integration of Gati Shakti Principles for multi-modal connectivity.

PROMISE: Make all efforts to ensure electrification of all railway tracks by 2022, smart railways across India.
STATUS AND COMMENTS: - As of 2022-23, 83% of the total broad gauge network electrified | - Record electrification of 6542 Route Kilometers (RKMs) achieved in 2022-23 | - 1,161 kilometers of double lines and 296 kilometers of sidings electrified, totaling 4100 Track Kilometers (TKMs) in 2022-23 | - 41% increase in electrification compared to the previous year | - North Central Railway and five other zonal railways 100% electrified | - The state of Uttarakhand achieved 100% electrification.

PROMISE: Work towards equipping all main railway stations with Wi-Fi facility.
STATUS AND COMMENTS: - Wi-Fi Availability: 6,108 railway stations across India offer free high-speed Wi-Fi. | - Top States with Wi-Fi Stations: Uttar Pradesh (768 stations), Maharashtra (566 stations), West Bengal (510 stations), Andhra Pradesh (509 stations), Rajasthan (463 stations). | - Service Provider: Wi-Fi service called RailWire, provided by RailTel. | - Usage Terms: Free internet access for the first 30 minutes each day at speeds up to 1 Mbps. | - Additional Data Packages: After free usage, additional data can be purchased, starting from Rs 10 for a 5 GB package at speeds up to 34 Mbps, valid for one day.
